- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.25) — reduce forecast by 1–3% for 30d horizon.
- Underestimate prices after strong upward spikes (e.g., >82) — add 0.5–1.5% to forecast to account for mean reversion.
- Overshoot in early 30d forecast when sentiment is neutral or slightly negative — cap forecast at 1–2% below recent 7d high.
- Lagged price movements (e.g., 30d forecast > 80 but true < 80) — adjust downward by 0.5–1.5% if sentiment is weak or flat.
- When sentiment is consistently positive but price fails to rise — reduce forecast slope by 10–20% to avoid overconfidence bias.
- For 30d horizon, if last 3 sentiment values are >0.3, reduce forecast by 1–2% to avoid overreaction to short-term sentiment.
